name: Masala roasted chickpeas

steps.text: Boil soaked chickpeas 20 minutes, drain, dry thoroughly.
steps.cue: A chickpea is just tender with a slight bite. Drain and dry it thoroughly.
steps.tip: Pat dry and leave on a towel for 10 minutes. Moisture is the enemy of crunch.

steps.text: Toss with oil and spices, roast at 200°C for 30 minutes, shaking halfway.
steps.cue: The chickpeas are golden and rattle on the tray. They crisp more as they cool.
steps.tip: Add the spices after roasting. Fine powder scorches in the oven.

storage: Crispest on the day. A loosely covered jar keeps them crunchy for 2 to 3 days; sealed tightly they soften. Re-crisp in a 180°C oven for 5 minutes.
